purpose: Size a lower-storage T16 b1 variant (root request 2026-09-28): which traces are needed, transport compression, scalar trace size.
method: Off-lane on mbit10 with nice 10, read-only over the retained T15 b3 uniform18 s0 r0 primary roi-debug.trace.gz (1,297,018,969 bytes). A 1-GiB decoded prefix was written to /data1/yanruj/tmp/t16-storage-20260928/sample.txt for single-threaded compression tests and then removed; no retained evaluation artifact was modified.

trace_composition.first_2e9_bytes_by_message: 95.7% IndirectAccess unit I[...] lines (fillRowTable, recvData, packets: MAAIndirect), 4.3% RangeFuser R[...] (MAARangeFuser); unit Start/End lines (MAATrace) about 0.01%
trace_composition.source_flags: At model e4fc4af, the unit Start/End lines are DPRINTF(MAATrace) in ALU.cc:79/834, IndirectAccess.cc:535/769, RangeFuser.cc:227, StreamAccess.cc:323; 'tile size' is MAARangeFuser (RangeFuser.cc:242); 'entries received'/'new_data[' are MAAIndirect (IndirectAccess.cc:879/927).

what_each_execution_needs.primary_accelerated: The frozen T16 requirement is candidate accelerator case 'executed': positive *.numInst counters plus completed S/I/R/A unit End lines, all MAATrace. Full/tail tile sizes (MAARangeFuser) and competing-parent stores (MAAIndirect) are not required; competing-parent updates are unobservable for the unmodified author binary anyway (no parent address is printed).
what_each_execution_needs.diagnostic: dx100-profile takes region metrics from the diagnostic stdout region counters and sealed statistics; the diagnostic trace is only re-validated for consistency with its own recorded coverage. No profile or package quantity depends on MAAIndirect or MAARangeFuser lines.
what_each_execution_needs.scalar: Scalar (BASE) traces are empty: 20-byte gzip streams in the R12 kron14 probe; the stopped uniform22 scalar primary wrote 0 bytes over 8,695 s.

zstd -19 -T1 --long=27.note: Approximate: the sample file received its final 3,481 bytes while zstd was reading, so the frame was incomplete; the ratio of the compressed prefix is still indicative.

decision: Use the MAATrace-only trace (verification.coverage false) for accelerated T16 executions. It keeps accelerator execution observed and removes about 99.99% of the trace volume. Uniform22 MAATrace estimate: 1.32 MB x 16 = about 21 MB decoded per execution. Better compression would save at most about 40% (zstd -19, at 55x the compression time, and would need a new gem5 transport). Scalar traces are already empty.
storage_estimate_low_storage: Per execution: the uniform22 checkpoint (about 0.52 GB; retained a1 run: 480 MB pmem + 41 MB cpt), plus logs and MAATrace trace. Six executions come to about 3.2 GB; with three driver ledgers, series streams and databases, about 7 GB. Planned 16 GiB (4 GiB per execution, 8 GiB per series) plus a 10-GiB raw reserve gives an admission floor of 26 GiB free on /data.
raw_location: mbit10 only; temporary sample and compressed copies removed 2026-09-28 13:06 ET.
